offline.title: You are offline
offline.body: What was loaded before is still shown. Your draft is kept.

loadFailed.title: Could not load {thing}
loadFailed.body: The server did not respond. Your filters are kept.

forbidden.title: You do not have access
forbidden.body: Ask a {role} to give you access to {place}.
forbidden.bodyGeneric: Ask someone who has access to add you.

notFound.title: This {object} no longer exists
notFound.body: It may have been deleted or moved.

expired.title: This confirmation has expired
expired.body: The request changed after you viewed it. Nothing was done. Review it again.

identityChanged.title: You signed in as a different account
identityChanged.body: Drafts from the other account are not shown here.
